question.text: A Rs. 1,000 face 10-year bond with 8% coupon. If YTM drops to 6%, the bond price:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Lower YTM => higher price; with coupon > YTM it trades at premium. **The Trap:** Falling price requires rising YTM. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in IV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Lock in gains by rebalancing when rates fall sharply into portfolio targets.
